_comment: Melbourne — generation-A workbook. IMPORTED AND LIVE: 13 published, 2 held. envelope was set 2026-07-31 from the MSA county list, not from the observed bbox — see _envelope_comment for the county used, the derivation rule and the containment cross-check.
_addendum_comment: SUPERSEDED FOR NEW DISCOVERY 2026-08-06 by scripts/metros/melbourne-v3.json, a v3 source-led addendum batch (greensboro-v3 / tampa-addendum precedent). DO NOT re-run this config to add venues. The addendum uses a SEPARATE batch tag (melbourne-v3-2026-08-06) and a separate config because candidate_key collides with this batch's pbmt-fl-### keys and would abort --stage=candidates, and it reuses this file's envelope verbatim and the SAME metro_area 'Melbourne' so it extends /courts/in/melbourne rather than creating a second metro page. The 15 rows this config owns are unioned against by the addendum, never re-imported. This config's own expected_publish block below still describes THIS batch (13/15) and remains correct; the addendum asserts its own split independently. The two held rows here (nancy-higgs-park-and-community-center, dinks-and-drives) are still held on 'no coordinate' and were deliberately not touched by the addendum.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the Palm Bay-Melbourne-Titusville, FL MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 1 MSA county (Brevard)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 13 geocoded venue(s) of 15 in this batch (observed lat 28.0093..28.6235, lng -80.8393..-80.5863).

same_site_pairs.note: Cocoa Beach Recreation Center / Tennis & Pickleball Complex (321 Ramp Road, 12 courts, fee) and Ramp Road Park (401 Ramp Road, outdoor) are distinct city facilities with distinct house numbers on the same road; the city lists them separately at https://www.cityofcocoabeach.com/547/Parks-with-Tennis-Pickleball-Courts. They geocoded 83 m apart onto the same OSM way.

fee_type.reason: the workbook prose "Program fees apply" was parked at 'unknown' by the prose-ambiguity rule; adjudication confirms a fee applies, which is ruling 1 branch 1 (unambiguous prose -> take it). The verbatim prose remains in public_notes and in provenance.fields.fee_type.workbook_value.
